question: total area residential buildings ha
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) / 10000 AS area_ha FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE subtype = 'residential';

question: total length footway roads km
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000 AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway';

question: average footprint area flat roof buildings m2
sql: SELECT AVG(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) AS avg_area_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE roof_shape = 'flat';

question: buildings area > 500 m2 height > 10 m id area height
sql: SELECT id, ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) AS area_m2, height FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) > 500 AND height > 10;

question: road segments longer than 200 m class length
sql: SELECT class, ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) AS length_m FROM lisbon_roads WHERE ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) > 200;

question: distance Torre VTS de Algés to nearest road m
sql: WITH building AS (SELECT geometry AS geom FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE names.primary = 'Torre VTS de Algés' LIMIT 1) SELECT ST_Distance_Spheroid(b.geom, r.geometry) AS distance_m FROM building b, lisbon_roads r ORDER BY distance_m LIMIT 1;
